title: Dev Tooling: uv, Rust & Nix
description: Drawn from the owner's working environment: uv-managed Python, Nix-first devShells, conventional commits.

questions.prompt: Which set of classic tools does `uv` aim to replace?
questions.explanation: uv is a single fast Python runtime + dependency + project manager covering pip/venv/pipx/poetry workflows.

questions.prompt: `uv run script.py` will auto-resolve and install the script's dependencies before running it.
questions.explanation: uv resolves the project/inline dependencies into the environment, then executes the script.

questions.prompt: Under Conventional Commits, what type prefix labels a bug fix?
questions.explanation: `fix:` marks a bug fix; `feat:` a feature; `chore:` maintenance.

questions.prompt: In a Nix-first setup, where are project CLI tools expected to come from?
questions.explanation: Nix-first: tools come from the devShell; `mise` is reserved for language runtimes only.
